C-FOCUS-CANON-COMPLETE.Name: Settings focus canon to the class, the unsaved-close dialog on the chrome stack and a locale-independent theme-toggle hook – implementation plan
C-FOCUS-CANON-COMPLETE.IntentSummary: Close the focus-and-typography canon debt of wave-5 bundle D as one implementation bundle over five product files and ten e2e specs. The visible-keyboard-focus canon of C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS (inherited verbatim: outline 2px solid var(--prefAccent), outline-offset 1px, :focus-visible only, no tabindex, no focus manager, real-keyboard evidence) lands on the three shared Settings control-set members still missing it, each as a file-local rule in its owner's existing style region: .pref-tab-page--appearance .theme-family-tile:focus-visible inside START_BLOCK_SWATCH_GRID_METRICS (src/renderer/src/prefComponents/tabs/appearance/index.vue, whose `all: unset` at :320 strips the outline the Quick Settings twin carries at viewTab.vue:319-322), .pref-range-item .pref-stepper-btn:focus-visible inside START_BLOCK_STEPPER_METRICS (src/renderer/src/prefComponents/common/range/index.vue :219-220, inherited by both consumers – the Settings fontSize/lineHeight rows and the Quick Settings Page width stepper – through the shared component) and .pref-button-item .pref-button:focus-visible inside START_BLOCK_BUTTON_METRICS (src/renderer/src/prefComponents/common/buttonRow/index.vue :75-76); the C-38 chrome font list (src/renderer/src/assets/styles/index.css:568-584) gains one selector so the live unsaved-changes dialog (.ag-unsaved-close-dialog, built by components/editorWithTabs/unsavedCloseDialog.js, styled font-size-only by unsavedCloseDialog.css) stops inheriting the user-agent stack and renders in var(--chromeFontFamily), with the vestigial .el-message-box block (:337-358, no remaining caller) left untouched as a named residual; and both titleBar theme-toggle variants (src/renderer/src/components/titleBar/index.vue :84-97 macOS nav, :151-163 caption cell) gain data-testid="titlebar-theme-toggle" following the modeChips.vue:58/:79 convention, with all eight locale-dependent e2e selectors (title*="Theme" / aria-label*="Theme" matching, dead under ru where the tooltip renders "Тема: …") swapped to the hook and a language:'ru' locale-rotation run added to titlebar-theme-toggle.spec.ts. Red-first is binding where behavior changes: the extended settings-shell focus routes, the computed font-family assertions on the open dialog and the swapped selectors are recorded red on the unchanged built renderer before any product edit, receipts preserved; the twin-consumption criterion (compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:349-355 and the QS stepper pins green through the change with zero edits) is recorded honestly as meaningful-proof. Governance travels in the same bundle: file-local CHANGE_SUMMARY entries in the four touched component files and the dated amendment line in the C-38 region comment, one M-011 SummaryDelta and the V-M-011 scenario entries naming the new pins; no editor.vue or muya work, no locale keys, no dependencies, no release.
